rules.description: Applicant must be at least 10 weeks pregnant OR have a child under 4 years old
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be at least 10 weeks pregnant or have a child under 4 years old to qualify for Healthy Start vouchers

rules.description: If pregnant, must be at least 10 weeks pregnant
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be at least 10 weeks pregnant. You can apply once you reach 10 weeks

rules.description: Applicant must receive a qualifying benefit
rules.reason_if_failed: You must receive Universal Credit, Child Tax Credit, Income Support, income-based Jobseeker's Allowance, Pension Credit, or income-related Employment and Support Allowance

rules.description: Applicant must be resident in England, Wales, or Northern Ireland
rules.reason_if_failed: Healthy Start is for England, Wales and Northern Ireland only. If you live in Scotland, apply for Best Start Foods instead.

rules.description: Applicants under 18 and pregnant are automatically eligible without benefits check
rules.reason_if_failed: As you are under 18 and pregnant, you qualify automatically. No benefits check needed.

explanation_template: Healthy Start vouchers eligibility: {outcome}. Voucher value: £{weekly_amount}/week

edge_cases.action: Calculate total voucher value: £4.25 per child under 1, plus £4.25 per child aged 1-4. Add £8.50 if pregnant.

edge_cases.description: Applicant is pregnant with twins or multiples
edge_cases.action: Standard pregnancy voucher applies (£8.50/week). After birth, each baby gets separate voucher (£4.25 each).

edge_cases.description: Applicant has applied for qualifying benefit but decision pending
edge_cases.action: Cannot proceed until benefits decision made. Advise to reapply once benefit confirmed.

edge_cases.description: Child will turn 4 during application period
edge_cases.action: Vouchers will stop on child's 4th birthday. System will automatically adjust.

edge_cases.description: Pregnant applicant does not have maternity exemption certificate
edge_cases.action: Handoff to midwife/doctor to obtain MATB1 or maternity exemption certificate first. Required for pregnancy verification.
